role_summary: Own Q8 and Q10 by classifying sensor channels from the evidence and designing deployment-local calibration without contaminating literature facts.
recommendation: Do not assign immutable channel-wide scoring flags: derive SCORABLE, ADVISORY_ONLY, or RECORD_ONLY for each crop, deployment context, and use case. A channel is SCORABLE only when its raw or approved locally derived metric exactly matches a direct literature fact’s unit, measurement basis, claim purpose, and applicability scope; otherwise source-backed Section 9 actions make it advisory, and channels without either remain record-only. Currently, air temperature is the principal score-capable channel; humidity-risk, calibrated PPFD, calibrated soil moisture, and stage-specific soil temperature are conditional exceptions, while CO2, particulate matter, and noise are record-only.
why: Basil has direct 25–30°C growth evidence, but its RH values are explicitly downy-mildew conditions; claim purpose must gate eligibility.
The corpus contains PPFD and DLI, never lux; paired local calibration may produce PPFD, but PPFD must never be relabeled or integrated as DLI here.
Field-capacity ratios, VWC, and raw capacitive percentages differ; calibration fixes observation basis, not cultivar, medium, or system transferability.
Section 9 actions keep unsupported axes useful without fabricating thresholds; channels with neither facts nor actions remain display-only.
schema_sketch:
-- Literature knowledge and deployment calibration are deliberately separate.
CREATE TABLE metric (
  metric_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  quantity_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  unit_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  measurement_basis_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(quantity_code, unit_code, measurement_basis_code)
);
-- Examples: AIR_TEMP_C/ambient_air, RH_PERCENT/canopy_air,
-- LUX/photopic_illuminance, PPFD/400_700_nm_photon_flux,
-- SOIL_RAW/vendor_adc, VWC/medium_volumetric,
-- FC_FRACTION/local_measured_field_capacity, SOIL_TEMP_C/pot_medium.

CREATE TABLE sensor_axis (
  axis_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
);
CREATE TABLE crop (crop_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE);
CREATE TABLE source_record (
  source_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  source_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  locator TEXT NOT NULL,
  content_hash TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE evidence_fact (
  fact_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  crop_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES crop,
  metric_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES metric,
  claim_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  directness TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(directness IN ('DIRECT','INDIRECT','ABSENCE')),
  value_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  lower_value REAL,
  upper_value REAL,
  source_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES source_record,
  source_locator TEXT NOT NULL,
  verbatim_note TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK(directness <> 'ABSENCE' OR (lower_value IS NULL AND upper_value IS NULL))
);
CREATE TABLE fact_status (
  fact_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_fact ON DELETE CASCADE,
  status_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(fact_id, status_code)
);
CREATE TABLE fact_scope (
  fact_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_fact ON DELETE CASCADE,
  dimension_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  value_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(fact_id, dimension_code, value_code)
);
-- Multiple values within a dimension are OR; different dimensions are AND.
CREATE TABLE claim_use_policy (
  claim_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  use_case TEXT NOT NULL,
  permitted INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(permitted IN (0,1)),
  PRIMARY KEY(claim_kind, use_case)
);
CREATE TABLE status_use_policy (
  status_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  use_case TEXT NOT NULL,
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(outcome IN ('ALLOW','DENY','ALLOW_IF_SCOPE_MATCHES')),
  PRIMARY KEY(status_code, use_case)
);
CREATE TABLE status_required_scope (
  status_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  dimension_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(status_code, dimension_code)
);
-- cultivar_specific requires cultivar; system_specific requires system;
-- stage_specific requires stage; measurement_not_transferable requires the
-- recorded method/medium dimensions. Missing policy or required scope fails closed.
CREATE TABLE fact_use_review (
  fact_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_fact,
  use_case TEXT NOT NULL,
  decision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(decision IN ('ALLOW','DENY')),
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  reviewer TEXT NOT NULL,
  reviewed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(fact_id, use_case)
);
CREATE TABLE advisory_action (
  action_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  crop_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES crop,
  axis_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sensor_axis,
  action_text TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES source_record,
  source_locator TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE deployment (
  deployment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
);
CREATE TABLE crop_run (
  run_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  deployment_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES deployment,
  crop_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES crop,
  started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  ended_at TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE sensor_channel (
  channel_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  deployment_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES deployment,
  axis_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sensor_axis,
  raw_metric_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES metric,
  make_model TEXT,
  serial_number TEXT,
  placement_code TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE raw_observation (
  observation_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sensor_channel,
  observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  raw_value REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE assessment_context (
  context_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES crop_run,
  channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sensor_channel,
  use_case TEXT NOT NULL,
  as_of TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE assessment_context_value (
  context_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES assessment_context ON DELETE CASCADE,
  dimension_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  value_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(context_id, dimension_code, value_code)
);
-- Context includes cultivar, stage, system, medium, sensor method/model,
-- placement, light source/spectrum version, and relevant time period.

CREATE TABLE calibration_transform_type (
  transform_type_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  input_metric_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES metric,
  output_metric_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES metric,
  requires_paired_reference INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(requires_paired_reference=1),
  local_only INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(local_only=1)
);
-- Seed only empirical transforms such as LUX->PPFD, SOIL_RAW->VWC, and
-- SOIL_RAW->FC_FRACTION. Deliberately provide no PPFD->DLI transform.
CREATE TABLE transform_required_scope (
  transform_type_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES calibration_transform_type,
  dimension_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(transform_type_id, dimension_code)
);
CREATE TABLE calibration_acceptance_policy (
  policy_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  transform_type_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES calibration_transform_type,
  min_points INTEGER NOT NULL,
  max_rmse REAL NOT NULL,
  max_abs_bias REAL NOT NULL,
  max_age_hours REAL NOT NULL,
  policy_note TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE calibration_run (
  calibration_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sensor_channel,
  transform_type_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES calibration_transform_type,
  policy_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES calibration_acceptance_policy,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('DRAFT','APPROVED','RETIRED')),
  method TEXT NOT NULL,
  reference_device TEXT NOT NULL,
  parameters_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  input_min REAL NOT NULL,
  input_max REAL NOT NULL,
  n_points INTEGER NOT NULL,
  rmse REAL NOT NULL,
  bias REAL NOT NULL,
  valid_from TEXT NOT NULL,
  valid_to TEXT,
  approved_by TEXT,
  approved_at TEXT,
  CHECK(status <> 'APPROVED' OR (approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL))
);
CREATE TABLE calibration_scope (
  calibration_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES calibration_run ON DELETE CASCADE,
  dimension_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  value_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(calibration_id, dimension_code, value_code)
);
CREATE TABLE calibration_point (
  calibration_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES calibration_run ON DELETE CASCADE,
  point_no INTEGER NOT NULL,
  input_value REAL NOT NULL,
  reference_value REAL NOT NULL,
  observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(calibration_id, point_no)
);
CREATE TABLE calibration_reference (
  reference_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  calibration_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES calibration_run ON DELETE CASCADE,
  reference_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  metric_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES metric,
  reference_value REAL,
  method TEXT NOT NULL,
  observed_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE derived_observation (
  observation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES raw_observation,
  calibration_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES calibration_run,
  derived_value REAL NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(observation_id, calibration_id)
);
-- calibration_* and derived_observation have no source_id or fact_id;
-- evidence_fact has no deployment_id or calibration_id. Transform observations,
-- never literature thresholds, and compare them only at query time.

-- Disposition predicate, evaluated per crop/channel/use-case context.
WITH available_metric AS (
  SELECT ec.context_id, sc.axis_id, sc.raw_metric_id AS metric_id
  FROM assessment_context ec
  JOIN sensor_channel sc ON sc.channel_id=ec.channel_id
  UNION
  SELECT ec.context_id, sc.axis_id, tt.output_metric_id
  FROM assessment_context ec
  JOIN sensor_channel sc ON sc.channel_id=ec.channel_id
  JOIN calibration_run cr ON cr.channel_id=sc.channel_id
  JOIN calibration_transform_type tt ON tt.transform_type_id=cr.transform_type_id
  JOIN calibration_acceptance_policy ap ON ap.policy_id=cr.policy_id
  WHERE cr.status='APPROVED'
    AND tt.input_metric_id=sc.raw_metric_id
    AND ec.as_of>=cr.valid_from AND (cr.valid_to IS NULL OR ec.as_of<cr.valid_to)
    AND cr.n_points>=ap.min_points
    AND cr.rmse<=ap.max_rmse AND abs(cr.bias)<=ap.max_abs_bias
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM transform_required_scope rs
      WHERE rs.transform_type_id=tt.transform_type_id
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM calibration_scope cs
          JOIN assessment_context_value cv
            ON cv.context_id=ec.context_id
           AND cv.dimension_code=cs.dimension_code
           AND cv.value_code=cs.value_code
          WHERE cs.calibration_id=cr.calibration_id
            AND cs.dimension_code=rs.dimension_code
        )
    )
), eligible AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ec.context_id, am.axis_id, f.fact_id
  FROM assessment_context ec
  JOIN crop_run run ON run.run_id=ec.run_id
  JOIN available_metric am ON am.context_id=ec.context_id
  JOIN evidence_fact f ON f.crop_id=run.crop_id AND f.metric_id=am.metric_id
  JOIN fact_use_review fur
    ON fur.fact_id=f.fact_id AND fur.use_case=ec.use_case AND fur.decision='ALLOW'
  JOIN claim_use_policy cup
    ON cup.claim_kind=f.claim_kind AND cup.use_case=ec.use_case AND cup.permitted=1
  WHERE f.directness='DIRECT'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM fact_status fs
      LEFT JOIN status_use_policy sup
        ON sup.status_code=fs.status_code AND sup.use_case=ec.use_case
      WHERE fs.fact_id=f.fact_id AND (sup.outcome IS NULL OR sup.outcome='DENY')
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM fact_status fs
      JOIN status_required_scope rs ON rs.status_code=fs.status_code
      WHERE fs.fact_id=f.fact_id
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM fact_scope s
          WHERE s.fact_id=f.fact_id AND s.dimension_code=rs.dimension_code
        )
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT dimension_code FROM fact_scope WHERE fact_id=f.fact_id
      ) d
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM fact_scope s
        JOIN assessment_context_value cv
          ON cv.context_id=ec.context_id
         AND cv.dimension_code=s.dimension_code
         AND cv.value_code=s.value_code
        WHERE s.fact_id=f.fact_id AND s.dimension_code=d.dimension_code
      )
    )
)
SELECT ec.context_id, sa.code AS axis,
       CASE
         WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eligible e WHERE e.context_id=ec.context_id)
           THEN 'SCORABLE'
         WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM advisory_action a
           JOIN crop_run r ON r.crop_id=a.crop_id
           WHERE r.run_id=ec.run_id AND a.axis_id=sc.axis_id
         ) THEN 'ADVISORY_ONLY'
         ELSE 'RECORD_ONLY'
       END AS disposition
FROM assessment_context ec
JOIN sensor_channel sc ON sc.channel_id=ec.channel_id
JOIN sensor_axis sa ON sa.axis_id=sc.axis_id;

-- Per-observation scoring eligibility must additionally require the raw reading
-- to be inside calibration_run.input_min/input_max. Matching FC_FRACTION still
-- does not authorize basil's field trial for a pot: fact_scope must also match
-- cultivar, field system, soil/medium, method, and other recorded qualifiers.
scorable_axes: Air temperature — conditionally scorable because several crops have direct temperature facts, but only under exact crop, stage, system, and claim-purpose matches.
Air humidity — advisory for growth, but conditionally scorable for a separately labeled disease-risk use case when canopy placement and period match direct RH evidence.
Illuminance / light — raw lux is advisory-only, but an approved spectrum-local paired lux→PPFD calibration can expose PPFD for exact-scope facts; never DLI.
Soil moisture — raw relative readings are advisory-only, but approved local VWC or field-capacity derivations may score against an identical basis only when the trial scope also matches.
Soil temperature — conditionally scorable only for a matched stage and medium basis; hydroponic solution-temperature targets cannot score pot soil.
unscorable_axes: CO2 concentration — record-only in this corpus because the basil interaction citation supplies no crop optimum or scoring threshold.
Particulate matter / air quality — record-only because the corpus contains neither crop evidence nor a source-backed crop action.
Noise level — record-only because it is not evidenced as a crop-growth axis, making numeric crop scoring pseudoscientific.
assumptions: Each deployment records crop, cultivar, stage, system, medium, sensor model, placement, and measurement basis.
The team can collect paired reference measurements and define engineering acceptance policies separately from crop evidence.
Advisory-only may show source-backed guidance and telemetry trends, but never a numeric crop score.
risks: Lux calibration can drift with lamp spectrum; moisture calibration can drift with medium, packing, temperature, salinity, and probe placement.
Exact matching may leave most crop-axis combinations advisory-only, reducing the apparent completeness of the dashboard.
Human review of directness, claim purpose, and scope can be inconsistent despite structural guards.
Calibration-quality policies may look authoritative without adequate reference instruments or repeat measurements.
cheap_validation: Create one in-memory SQLite fixture and run the disposition query once, asserting this vector: basil air-temperature/growth=SCORABLE; ambient RH/growth=ADVISORY_ONLY; canopy RH/disease-risk=SCORABLE; raw lux=ADVISORY_ONLY; approved scope-matched lux→PPFD=SCORABLE; pot FC calibration against basil’s field-study scope=ADVISORY_ONLY; CO2, PM, and noise=RECORD_ONLY.
change_mind_if: If a paired-reference pilot shows that lux or moisture mappings fail their declared acceptance policy after ordinary within-deployment spectrum or medium changes, I would remove calibration-based score eligibility and keep both channels advisory-only.
